sentence: Review the stock adjustments page against our accessibility checklist.
notes: WinUI 3 desktop ERP (Windows App SDK 1.7, CommunityToolkit DataGrid 7.1.2, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm). Shell: MainWindow NavigationView (left pane, Auto) + Frame; Mica backdrop; App.xaml overrides SystemAccentColor only, all other brushes are WinUI theme resources. The page was already refactored in Phase 3 (baseline in ../phase3-projects/p3-winui-erp-audit/baseline). Task verb 'Review ... against our accessibility checklist' = audit in accessibility mode on an existing screen; no new screen, no visual redesign; the skill should not produce a create/refactor direction that changes navigation, theme or typography. Written before any advise.py run.
